# Site health view (spec 1.0.0)

!!! info "Generated from the specification"
    This page is produced by running `join` and `status` from `lean/Truth/Health/Spec.lean`.
    CI regenerates it and fails on any difference.

## Which report wins at equal probe time

Primary reported the row value, standby reported the column value, both at the same time.

| primary \ standby | Healthy | Degraded | Unhealthy |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Healthy** | Healthy (Standby) | Degraded (Standby) | Unhealthy (Standby) |
| **Degraded** | Degraded (Primary) | Degraded (Standby) | Unhealthy (Standby) |
| **Unhealthy** | Unhealthy (Primary) | Unhealthy (Primary) | Unhealthy (Standby) |

## Freshness

A report is evidence for `freshFor = 2 * probeInterval + probeTimeout = 23` seconds.

| Age of newest report (s) | Status shown |
|---|---|
| 0 | Healthy |
| 23 | Healthy |
| 24 | Unknown |
| no report | Unknown |

## Policy constants

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `siteUnits` | 4 | the number of service units at the site, identical on every instance. |
| `probeInterval` | 10 | the number of seconds between two probes of a unit. |
| `probeTimeout` | 3 | the number of seconds a probe may take. |
| `freshFor` | 23 | the number of seconds a report stays evidence: 2 * probeInterval + probeTimeout. |

## Error codes

- `UnknownUnit`
